title: WRAPCOLS and WRAPROWS ignore an error in pad_with when no padding cell is needed and lift over array wrap_count
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, WRAPCOLS and WRAPROWS require wrap_count >= 1 (0 gives #NUM!) and only use pad_with for trailing incomplete rows or columns: when no padding is needed, an error passed in pad_with (such as #VALUE!) is ignored. When wrap_count is an array, Excel lifts the call over wrap_count's shape.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in fn2_questions (fn2_q011, fn2_q012, fn2_q074, fn2_q075), f3_arrays (rows 29-30), and jnt_aggregate_arrays (rows 101-102), and matched across 3,000/3,000 WRAPCOLS and 3,000/3,000 WRAPROWS full-bank rows.
